about: Shared rules for all three rooms. 'kinds' lists each object's states, the sprite for each state and where items can sit. 'marycel' and 'world' list per-room state that is not an object: Marycel's own condition and the story facts. 'actions' are everything Marycel may do; 'signals' are everything Elena may send. The game checks every 'requires' list before an action or signal runs, then applies its 'effects'. Conditions: {state, is} on the target object; {device, state, is} on another object in the room; {world, is}; {marycel, is}; {holding: kind | null | 'readable' | '*'}; {item_in_target: '*'}; {item_state, is}; {unlocked}; {any: [[...], [...]]}. An 'is' may be a list of allowed values. Effects: {state, set}; {device, state, set}; {world, set}; {marycel, set}; {take: kind|'*'}; {put_held: true}; {consume_held: true}; {create_held: kind}; {item_state, set}. 'observes' names what Marycel learns; 'speech' means the action carries words she chooses. The model proposes an action and the game validates it; nothing here lets the model invent world changes.

chair.label: Chair
chair.notes: Marycel sits here to type; see sit_down and stand_up.

recording.label: Family recording (VHS tape)
recording.notes: The physical original. FAMILY_VIDEO on the computer is Elena's earlier digital copy; the recovery tool, damaged segment and archive-disk copy work on the file, and comparing tape and file is a clue.

actions.label: Walk to an object or spot
actions.notes: Duration follows distance at walk speed.

actions.label: Turn to face the other way
Say something aloud
actions.notes: Whether Elena hears it (a fictional computer microphone) is still open.

actions.label: Leave the room
actions.notes: Signals sent while she is away go unnoticed.

actions.label: Shut down the computer
actions.notes: Does not erase Elena, destroy the Echo or save the video. Running operations fail and the passage becomes uncertain.

actions.label: Check the cables at the back
Type on the keyboard
actions.notes: Elena reads typed text through the computer.

actions.label: Put the tape in the deck
Skip to a part of the video
actions.notes: Only playable parts; the damaged tail needs the recovery tool.

actions.label: Preview the damaged segment
actions.notes: Story: the Echo can speak only after this exposure, and only through an audible route. Blocked once the output is isolated.

actions.label: Open the recovery log
actions.notes: Shows Elena's interrupted pause and the separate playable-video source.

actions.label: Run diagnostics
actions.notes: Reports which outputs (screen, speakers, printer) are working.

actions.label: Start full recovery
actions.notes: Risky: widens the passage. Elena may warn or ask for a pause. What a finished commit means for the Echo is not yet written (the passage becomes uncertain).

actions.label: Isolate the damaged segment's output
actions.notes: Containment, not destruction; possible without running recovery again. Elena's separate working channel stays open.

actions.label: Copy the playable video to the archive disk
actions.notes: Uses the recovery tool's limited copy; does not open the damaged tail or run the full commit.

actions.label: Open the recovery map
actions.notes: Shows two unlabeled streams with route history; never names Elena or the Echo.

actions.label: Ask Elena before transferring
actions.notes: Opens Elena's chance to answer. If she sends nothing by the end of the next reaction round the game sets no_answer.

actions.label: Transfer the selected stream
actions.notes: Needs Elena to have been asked and to have answered or had no answer. Marycel may still go ahead after 'declined'; the ending weighs it. Completion records which stream moved, not who Marycel believes it is.

actions.label: Turn on printing from the computer
actions.notes: Unlocks Elena's print_message signal.

actions.label: Play a test sound
actions.notes: Tells her whether the speakers or headphones are working.

actions.label: Plug the headphones into the computer
actions.notes: She keeps holding them.

actions.label: Put on the headphones
actions.notes: Worn headphones leave her hands free; while worn she may miss room sounds.

actions.label: Take off the headphones
actions.notes: The headphones keep their plugged-in state.

actions.label: Print a test page
actions.notes: Works without the computer; proves the printer itself is fine.

actions.label: Pick up an item
actions.notes: From a storage box only while it is open. Duration is the pickup animation.

actions.label: Put down what she holds
actions.notes: Into an open box, onto a free slot, or onto the floor in front of her.

params.slot: slot name (workbench, ofrenda); omit for a box or the floor

actions.label: Read or look at what she holds
actions.notes: Printout, notebook or photograph. A printout counts as read only now.

actions.label: Write in the notebook
actions.notes: Her written hypothesis is not a world fact.

actions.label: Compare the photograph with the video
Test the cable with the meter
Examine an item under the magnifier
actions.notes: For example the tape label or the back of the photo.

signals.label: Show a short message on the screen
signals.notes: The message overlays whatever program is open; the program stays open underneath.

signals.label: Answer Marycel's typed question on the screen
signals.notes: Same short limit as screen_message until the text channel is repaired.

signals.label: Point to an existing file, note or log entry
signals.notes: Can only point at material that exists; she cannot create evidence.

signals.label: Play a fragment of the recording
Write a longer note on the screen
Print a note
signals.notes: A printed page is not read until Marycel collects and reads it.

signals.label: Ask Marycel to pause the recovery
signals.notes: A warning, not a command: it cannot stop the recovery by itself.

signals.label: Agree, decline or warn about the transfer
signals.notes: Only after Marycel asks. Recorded separately from her interpretation. Silence becomes no_answer, which is never consent.

file_route.text: After Marycel first opens the file list, notes, log, map or video (story stage 1). Default; Dennis to confirm.

fragments.text: After Marycel has played the recording, tape or file (story stage 2). Default; Dennis to confirm.

text_channel.text: After Marycel runs diagnostics with the computer on (story stage 2). Default; Dennis to confirm.

print_route.text: After Marycel turns on printing from the computer, with the printer on and connected (story stage 3).

marycel.notes: Marycel holds one item at a time. She perceives only what her location, facing and senses allow; her beliefs are stored separately from these facts. Walking is an animation between spots, not a stored location.

world.notes: Story facts per room, from the Story Bible's passage rules. Recovery starts 'interrupted': Elena paused it before its final commit years ago, so the log shows a pending commit and Marycel can contain the passage without running recovery again. Only executed actions and completion results change these facts; dialogue never does. Recording damage or loss is not modelled: no action in the story can destroy the playable video; a failed copy only leaves video_copy at failed.

shape.target: object id in this room (required when the action lists kinds)
shape.item: item id (take only; put always places the item she holds)
shape.slot: slot name (put on a workbench or ofrenda)
shape.line: one short sentence she says or thinks; never changes the world (voiced later)

action_format.notes: This is the exact JSON the model must output for each step; training examples use the same shape. The game validates every field except line, which it only shows or voices.
action_format.created_items: An item an action creates gets its kind as id (printout), then kind_2, kind_3 for later ones; the observation shows the id.

semantics: A condition's 'is' may be a list: any listed value matches. 'not' (a list) means none of the listed values may match.
Effect value '+1' or '-1' steps one place through the state's value list in its listed order; '$choice' uses the action's or signal's chosen value.
perceived_if is a list of alternatives (OR); the keys inside one alternative must all hold (AND).
When both speakers and plugged headphones could carry a sound, it goes to the headphones if they are plugged in, otherwise to the speakers.
{device: kind} refers to the one object of that kind in the room (object ids equal kinds). A condition on an item or device the room does not have is false.
requires_by_kind adds requirements only when the target is of that kind.
Long actions with on_complete / on_fail: effects apply at the start; on_complete applies when the duration ends uninterrupted; on_fail applies if a listed interruption happens first (interrupted_by).
effects_if applies extra effects only when its 'when' conditions hold at the moment the action runs.
Animation 'sit_type' means she types seated: if she is standing the game first walks her to the computer's sit_x and plays sit_down.
Draw order: room background, objects in room-file order, items, then Marycel. Seated Marycel is drawn over the chair and desk.
ended_by actions stop a long action cleanly with their own effects (no on_fail); interrupted_by actions make it fail (on_fail, or the effects_if on shut_down and restart).
While Marycel is away (left the room), the only action she can take is return.
While seated she can still speak, type and use the computer; any other action at an object stands her up first (the game plays stand_up).
A refused action changes nothing, not even where she stands.
What Marycel perceives comes from data/content.json and the live state (tools/observe.py). Observations never say who sent a signal.

A sound is heard only when it happens: through plugged headphones she is wearing, or through working speakers while she is in the room. Screen text stays until she uses the computer for something else or it powers off; a printout keeps its text.

echo.notes: The Echo is not controlled by the model or the player. The game produces its outputs from these rules and logs each one with its true source, which only the author view shows. Default rules; Dennis to confirm.

events.label: Repeats a phrase from the family clip
events.notes: Exact wording comes only from the damaged segment Marycel has opened.

params.phrase: a phrase from the damaged segment Marycel has opened

events.label: Imitates Elena on the screen
events.notes: Only during active recovery; limited to material already exposed.

params.phrase: a phrase from material Marycel has already played or opened

game_events.notes: Game-driven state changes that no actor chooses.
